Fun Facts[]

  • This Station was named Twin Hills Station at the planning stages, and was located at approximately 1km to the east of where the station currently is.[2]
  • Despite Platform 2 of this station being underground, Platform Gates are still used at this station as this station is located at a valley between two mountains.
  • The Concourse of this Station is located at the Southeastern corner of this station. As it is located at a slightly higher altitude than Platform 2, it is only located to the Concourse by a Slope instead of elevators and stairs.

History[]

  • June 18 2021: This station began services.
  • September 21 2021: This station is chosen as the venue for the Mid-Autumn Festival backshot.[3]

Pointdown Isle was one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. At the time of its existence, it was located to the southeast of Bufly Island. However, due to the lack of usable land on Bufly Island, this isle, alongside Butterfly Head Isle and Beak Isle were reclaimed by Bufly Island. As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that this station is simultaneously situated on Desert and Plains biome. Quin Biome Station of Terracept Division is named in a similar manner.
  • This station features the first pair of Cross-platform interchange between a Standard Railway line and a Veloduct in Nazca Railway.[2]
  • The design of Eastbiome Station pays tribute to this station.

History[]

  • October 1 2016: This station began services alongside East Ring Line and Charlie Line.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • January 4 2021: This station began and completed expansion of the Swift Line Part.
  • January 5 2021: Swift Line extends from Novel Station to this station.
  • June 13 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[4]

Ponsand Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. While this island is a part of the Dai Wood City plan of Nazca Ferry, there is still no development seen on this island.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Other Railways
    • 2.3 Nazca Ferry
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

This island is located at the east of West Metropolis Archipelago, and to the west of Threeler.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

While this island features a set of emergency platforms for Arcgo Line, it does not stop at this island.

Other Railways[]

Ponsand Island Station is set up on this island when Southern Loop was still under construction. However, despite the platforms having been completed, the station is still not yet in use.

Nazca Ferry[]

  • Ponsand Island Pier

Poon Tong Station is a station on Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern North. This station will serve Glinstrouß Line and Everchord Line in the future.[2]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Shorebound Gleam.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Shorebound Gleam 03:09
Lustered Ripples 02:48

Fun Facts[]

  • The letters POT, which stands for the Abbreviation of this station, is seen at the east end of the concourse.
  • Land has been reclaimed to the east of the station in order to smoothen the track transition from the Elevated Section to the Ground Section. The shape of the reclaimed land also resembles the Millennium Falcon.
  • A Public Transport Interchange that can serve up to 20 bus routes is constructed outside the only exit of this station. The large number of lines is to facilitate future Glinstrouß Line and Everchord Line Development.
  • The East End of the Phoenix Line Platforms are curved in a fashion similar to that of Abunest West Station.

Future Development[]

  • Glinstrouß Line and Everchord Line will extend to this station and turn this station into a three-line interchange.

History[]

  • November 29 2024: This Station began construction.
  • November 30 2024: This Station completed construction.[3]
  • December 1 2024: This Station began services alongside Phoenix Line.

Portubra Island Station is a station on Pegasus Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Rover.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Name of this Station, as well as the Island on which this station is located, is an amalgam of the words Portugal and Brazil. This is due to the fact that the shape of the island resembles the shape of Brazil and South America,[2] with Brazil being a former colony of the Portuguese Empire.
  • To allude to the name of this station, the Station Signs adopt the shape and color scheme of the Brazilian Flag.
  • Lime Wool pointing towards the Platform are available on the floor at the Platform passageways. This design ensures that passengers who look down on the floor can reach the platforms.

History[]

  • July 2 2022: This Station completed construction.[3]
  • July 3 2022: This Station began services.

Potato Farmland Station is a station on Minecraft Line and Charlie Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line, Snow White Line (Potato Farmland Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The Los Sengas Coffee at this station only provides potatoes, featuring Potatoes, Baked Potatoes, Fried Potatoes and Braised Potatoes.[2]
  • The Seats at Los Sengas Coffee at this station face the underground Potato Farmland and is arranged in a row, a rare instance in Nazca Railway.

History[]

  • December 4 2021: This Station began services.
  • October 15 2022: Exit E is added to this station to connect to the Nawis Railway Station of the Same Name.[3]

Prosand Station/Node is a station on Stadium Line and The Shuttle. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Yowah. This station will serve Wingthorn Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to Yowah Line, Prosand Corridor, Torrent Express, Cadence Line, Hook Sand Line, Hook Sand Rapid, Hook Sand Express of the Co-Op Railway (Prosand Station) and NR Buses Route R41.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was formerly served by Echo Line and Bravo Line. However, in Season 2, Episode 17, due to the short interstation distance between Kong Corner Station and this staiton, Bravo Line ceased services at this station. Currently, the former Bravo Line platforms serve as emergency platforms only.
  • This station is the first station except for Metropolis Terminal to feature Standard Railway service and The Shuttle service at the same time. As a result, this station also became the first station to be marked as "Station/Node". However, it should also be noted that both "Station" and "Node" represents the Area Station class.
  • This station is the last of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate the class teacher of the Railway Builder at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Kong Corner Station and Raytree Station.
  • The Chinese name of this station alludes to Warsaw, the capital of Poland.
  • The Mini Classroom at The Shuttle Concourse contains a few joke banners that describes a typical Classroom in Hong Kong. The joke banners are described as follows:
    • Bulletin Board: "No one gives this a s*it except competition day", "Only teachers are always seeing this", "Every teacher does comment your bulletin board at least once."
    • Projectors: "Usually, the person who isn't tall enough is responsible for turning on the projector."
    • Ceiling Fans: "Please, Oh Goodness! Don't Fall!"
    • Blackboard: "Usually the last row can't see it due to short-sightedness", "Or the dude in front of you is taller than you."

History[]

  • March 29 2016: This station began operations alongside Stadium Line and Echo Line. Echo Line is established.
  • March 25 2017: Echo Line merged with Bravo Line, and this station became a Bravo Line Station.
  • January 14 2018: Bravo Line ceased services at this station.
  • May 4 2020: This station began expansion of The Shuttle part.[4]
  • May 5 2020: The Shuttle part of this station completed expansion. Metropolis Link, Katadelphia City Center Link and Media City Link began operations.
  • October 19 2021: The Shuttle section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]
  • April 22 2023: Exit G is added to this station to connect to Prosand Eastside.
  • November 23 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

It is located at Los Sengas Yowah Prosand. This station currently has 14 platforms, and passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Wingthorn Line, The Shuttle (Prosand Station/Node) and NR Buses Route R41.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 1300th page of this wiki.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station shares structure with SLT Prosand Stop, which is no longer operational.
  • This station is the largest station involved in the Co-Op Railway Scheme.
  • As this station is the largest station in Yowah District, this station serves as the transport hub for Yowah.
  • Due to historical reasons, CYR still manages Exits A1 and A2, as well as the north end of the exit corridor. However, the entirety of that area belongs to the non-fare zone and is only used as exit passageways and connections with the pedestrian walkway towards Exit B.
  • Due to the fact that the ACR Platforms are constructed later on, it shares space with the STR Section of this station and does not have its own exits or concourses.

Future Development[]

  • In response to the Yowah Line Rerouting Works, the Current Yowah Line Wing will be abolished.

Description[]

Prospektious Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Peckern North, and will extend to the northwest in the future.

This route is represented by Pink on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 24.

This line is 1.44 km long, and has a total of 2 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S3E19: Kivotos - Havenore

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northwest from the Zero Station of Kivotos Station to Havenore Station, acting as the connecting line between Arcgo Line and Glinstrouß Line in the process. This is the first section of this line. Completed
(Chapter: S3E19)
Extend Northwest from Havenore Station and arrive at new areas. TBC

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Just because you can't jump onto the podium of the souvenir doens't mean that you can't get the souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a snowball.

Fun Facts[]

  • At the west side of the Concourse at this station, a station art is set up highlighting the colored wools that would be used at the four Group 1 Gateways. The coloured wool are as follows:
    • Intus Occident: Purple Wool, Pink Wool
    • Intus Orient: Yellow Wool, Orange Wool
    • Intus Aquilo: Brown Wool, Red Wool
    • Intus Austrum: Lime Wool, Light Blue Wool

History[]

  • July 30 2015: This station began services.
  • June 15 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works. At the same day, Stadium Line extends to Intus Occident Gateway.[2][3]
  • February 27 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • March 1 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Pure Water Line is one of the lines constructed in Period 6 of Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It currently has six stations, and runs between Purity Corner and Waterbelt Garden. It is operated by Creeper Railway.

Contents

  • 1 Description

  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

Description[]

Pure Water Line is a light rail line of Creeper Railway.

The main use of this line is to connect the three lines (Stadium Line, East Ring Line and Cometsilk Line) at the Silk Pond area for more convenient interchange between these three lines.

History[]

  • October 11 2019: This line began construction.
  • August 2 2020 : Phase I of this line between Waterbelt Garden Station and Gentle Island Station began operations.
  • June 5 2021: Waterbelt River Station began operations.
  • June 11 2021: Gentle Island Pond Station began operations.
  • October 31 2021: Phase II of this line between Purity Forest Station and Purity Corner Station began operations.

Fun Facts[]

  • After the construction of this station, the scale of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division has surpassed Terracept Division.
  • This station is named after the colleague of the Railway Builder's mother, and was built as her birthday station.[2]
  • This station used to house a Los Sengas Coffee at the concourse. However, since Season 3, Episode 11, it has been demolished.
  • This station is the only station built for Daring Line in Season 2.

History[]

  • January 3 2017: The Ground Structure and Delta Line Platforms of this station completed construction.[3]
  • January 5 2017: This Station began services.

Purple Gate Station is a station on Peckern City Circular and Peckern South-East Coast Line. It is operated by Cities Transit, and is located in Los Sengas Peckern. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Expo Line, Delta Line (Purple Gate Station).
